text: Appeal of Order to Comply (August 27, 2018) for 313 Manor Road East.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated August 27, 2018, regarding the property located at 313 Manor Road East, Folder No. 18 215752 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to December 5, 2018.
